basic_info.description: This spacious family home is on the market for the first time in 60 years, located in the dynamic Inner Mission neighborhood of San Francisco. It has been lived in and loved by multiple generations. Main floor has two bedrooms and one bath, an eat-in kitchen, a front room, a family room, and a laundry area.  Upstairs you'll find three additional bedrooms and another bath.  Behind the garage you'll find flexible bonus space and a large yard. The possibilities are endless.  Vibrant and diverse the Inner Mission is known for its cultural richness, artistic scene, culinary delights, and lively nightlife. The neighborhood boasts excellent walkability (95 Walk Score), with plentiful public transportation options, including the 24th St BART station and various bus lines (80 Transit Score). It's also a biker's paradise (99 Bike Score). This home offers a unique opportunity to own a piece of Inner Mission history with huge potential to modernize and customize to your own personal preferences and lifestyle.
